page: Amazon Web Services r8idn.24xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. The hardware profile includes 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 48 physical Intel cores using the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz with two threads per core. System memory totals 768.0 GB, delivering an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio suited for workloads requiring substantial RAM allocation alongside multithreaded compute capacity.

For local data operations, the instance incorporates 5,700 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage. Network performance is anchored by a 150 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating high-throughput data transfer and low-latency node-to-node communication. The instance does not feature discrete GPU hardware accelerators or bundled complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dense pairing of 768.0 GB memory, 150 Gbps network bandwidth, and direct-attached NVMe storage delivers high resource consolidation, minimizing external storage I/O bottlenecks for cache-heavy architectures. This server profile is well matched for in-memory databases, distributed caching grids, large-scale ETL processing, real-time analytics engines, and transactional database clusters requiring high local I/O performance.
